div.div:
عَرِنٌ the masc. epithet applied to a horse, or similar beast, signifying Having the disease termed عَرَن [q. v.]: (TA:) the fem. epithet having this meaning is عَرِنَةٌ; with which ↓ عَرُونٌ is syn. (K, TA.) ＝
-A2- Also One who keeps close to the يَاسِر [or slaughterer, or superintendent of the slaughtering and of the division, of the camel for the game called المَيْسِر], in order that he may eat of the slaughtered camel. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
